Meta.title: Taksu Tech: robotics built by young Balinese engineers
Meta.description: Taksu Tech, part of Ezra Robotics: Bali receptionist robots (Snow, Timo, and Taksu Kiosk) and education robot kits for primary to senior high, with a simulator and a full curriculum.

hero.title: Robots for lobbies and classrooms
hero.body: Taksu Tech designs receptionist robots, service kiosks, and robot kits for schools. We make the electronics, the software, and the teaching materials ourselves.

board.alt: The SMP v1 robot controller board with the ESP32 module, a row of white connectors, and the power regulator
board.caption: The SMP v1 robot controller board, designed in-house.

connectors.name: Module connectors
connectors.role: Sensors and motors plug in without soldering

power.name: Power regulator
power.role: Feeds battery power to the whole board

divisions.title: Two product lines
divisions.intro: One team in Bali that designs, installs, teaches, and maintains the robots.

aksara.title: Follows the Aksara Bali regulation
aksara.body: Screens and printouts show Aksara Bali above Latin, following Bali Governor Regulation 80/2018.

kiosk.title: A kiosk built in Bali
kiosk.body: Taksu Kiosk is assembled in Bali with high local content and a built-in printer.

kka.title: Aligned with the KKA subject
kka.body: The education curriculum maps to the elective Coding and Artificial Intelligence subject.

simulator.title: Free to try in the browser
simulator.body: The robot simulator and kiosk demos work without signing in.

demos.title: Try it in your browser
demos.intro: Talk to a receptionist robot, print a visitor pass, or program a robot in the simulator.
demos.launcher: Pick your own robot and sample venue

cta.title: Want to see the robots in person?
cta.body: We can visit your office, hotel, or school for a demo.

Demo.metaDescription: Talk to a Bali receptionist robot, print a visitor pass, build your own kiosk in Studio, or program a robot in the simulator.

About.metaDescription: Taksu Tech is robotics built by young Balinese engineers under Ezra Robotics: Bali receptionist robots and education robots.
About.title: About Taksu Tech
About.parentBody: Ezra Robotics integrates robots for inspection, safety, and commercial services across Indonesia. Taksu Tech is its Bali-based unit.
About.aksaraTitle: About the Aksara Bali on this site
About.aksaraBody: The Balinese script is generated by our transliteration library. For official signage and content, we review it with Balinese speakers and language advisers.
